title: A bHLH heterodimer regulates germ cell differentiation in land plant gametophytes.
authors: Saito, Misaki; Momiki, Ryosuke; Ebine, Kazuo; Yoshitake, Yoshihiro; Nishihama, Ryuichi; Miyakawa, Takuya; Nakano, Takeshi; Mitsuda, Nobutaka; Araki, Takashi; Kohchi, Takayuki; Yamaoka, Shohei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究bHLH异二聚体调控陆地植物配子体生殖细胞分化，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Land plants are a monophyletic group of photosynthetic eukaryotes that diverged from streptophyte algae about 470 million years ago. During both the alternating haploid and diploid stages of the life cycle, land plants form multicellular bodies.(1)(,)(2)(,)(3)(,)(4) The haploid multicellular body (gametophyte) produces progenitor cells that give rise to gametes and the reproductive organs.(5)(,)(6)(,)(7)(,)(8) In the liverwort Marchantia polymorpha, differentiation of the initial cells of gamete-producing organs (gametangia) from the gametophyte is regulated by MpBONOBO (MpBNB), a member of the basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) transcription factor subfamily VIIIa. In Arabidopsis thaliana, specification of generative cells in developing male gametophytes (pollen) requires redundant action of BNB1 and BNB2.(9) Subfamily XI bHLHs, such as LOTUS JAPONICUS ROOTHAIRLESS LIKE1 (LRL1)/DEFECTIVE REGION OF POLLEN1 (DROP1) and LRL2/DROP2 in A. thaliana and the single LRL/DROP protein MpLRL in M. polymorpha, are the evolutionarily conserved regulators of rooting system development.(10) Although the role of LRL1/DROP1 and LRL2/DROP2 in gametogenesis remains unclear, their loss leads to the formation of abnormal pollen devoid of sperm cells.(11) Here, we show that BNBs and LRL/DROPs co-localize to gametophytic cell nuclei and form heterodimers. LRL1/DROP1 and LRL2/DROP2 act redundantly to regulate BNB expression for generative cell specification in A. thaliana after asymmetric division of the haploid microspore. MpLRL is required for differentiation of MpBNB-expressing gametangium initial cells in M. polymorpha gametophytes. Our findings suggest that broadly expressed LRL/DROP stabilizes BNB expression, leading to the formation of an evolutionarily conserved bHLH heterodimer, which regulates germ cell differentiation in the haploid gametophyte of land plants.
abstract_zh: 陆生植物是一个单系群的光合真核生物，约在4.7亿年前从链型藻类分化而来。在生活史中交替的单倍体和二倍体阶段，陆生植物均形成多细胞体。(1)(,)(2)(,)(3)(,)(4) 单倍体多细胞体（配子体）产生祖细胞，进而形成配子和生殖器官。(5)(,)(6)(,)(7)(,)(8) 在地钱（*Marchantia polymorpha*）中，配子产生器官（配子囊）的初始细胞从配子体分化受MpBONOBO（MpBNB）调控，该蛋白属于碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（basic helix-loop-helix, bHLH）转录因子亚家族VIIIa。在拟南芥（*Arabidopsis thaliana*）中，发育中的雄配子体（花粉）内生殖细胞的特化需要BNB1和BNB2的冗余作用。(9) 亚家族XI bHLH，如拟南芥中的LOTUS JAPONICUS ROOTHAIRLESS LIKE1（LRL1）/DEFECTIVE REGION OF POLLEN1（DROP1）和LRL2/DROP2，以及地钱中的单一LRL/DROP蛋白MpLRL，是根系系统发育的进化保守调控因子。(10) 尽管LRL1/DROP1和LRL2/DROP2在配子发生中的作用仍不清楚，但它们的缺失会导致形成缺乏精子细胞的异常花粉。(11) 在此，我们显示BNBs和LRL/DROPs共定位于配子体细胞核并形成异源二聚体。LRL1/DROP1和LRL2/DROP2在拟南芥中冗余作用，调控BNB表达，以在单倍体小孢子不对称分裂后进行生殖细胞特化。MpLRL是地钱配子体中表达MpBNB的配子囊初始细胞分化所必需的。我们的发现表明，广泛表达的LRL/DROP稳定BNB表达，导致形成进化保守的bHLH异源二聚体，该二聚体调控陆生植物单倍体配子体中的生殖细胞分化。
